explanation: From this branch: expressionUnits.ts gains resolveExpressionUnit, the one spelling of the registry-first unit rule, which buildPopData and the Node bundle reader share; browser behaviour is unchanged. From main (#35): src/data/queryWire.ts owns the query-index wire format (names, envelopes, row codecs, trackEntry with qcFlags lowPower) and queryIndex.ts is its read adapter; crossDataset readers decode rows through it with unchanged bytes.
